spans.s: autpātika, nt. (v.l. autpatika, which is Mironovʼs reading but can hardly be right; to utpāta plus -ika, cf. Skt. autpātika, adj., in different mg.), apparently a sudden, offhand invitation (to eat), or food thus offered (follows nimantranakam): Mvy 〔5764〕 = Tib. ḥphral ba bos pa, sudden invitation.
